reuseSurvey.internal: Reused the existing isolated SP01 Taro sample shape and type-check scripts; no production page or SP07 project was created.
reuseSurvey.official: Reviewed the official Taro 4.3.2 release and installed @tarojs/cli 4.3.2 default template. The candidate configuration and synthetic page remain adapted from the already-audited 4.3.1 template so this test isolates the toolchain upgrade. The default 4.3.2 template was not copied because it adds optional sample/platform configuration and includes PropsWithChildren<any>, conflicting with the project no-any rule.
reuseSurvey.thirdParty: No additional third-party library was introduced. Taro package metadata and installed source were inspected; sampled CLI and webpack runner packages declare MIT and Node >=18. The exact webpack runner peer is webpack 5.91.0.
reuseSurvey.decision: Keep as a reversible local comparison only. Do not freeze for the formal app until remaining type and security risks are reviewed.

publicRegistryAudit.comparisonUnit: npm audit affected package entries and metadata severity totals; not unique advisories, exploit counts, or product vulnerabilities

productionDependencyAudit.exitCodeMeaning: npm audit reports vulnerabilities; nonzero is the observed audit result, not an infrastructure or command failure
productionDependencyAudit.comparison: The production-only audit totals are identical for the 4.3.1 baseline and 4.3.2 candidate. Critical counts are affected package entries, not unique advisories.
productionDependencyAudit.scopeLimit: --omit=dev follows npm dependency classification for these isolated manifests; it does not establish shipped mini-program bundle reachability, exploitability, or product vulnerability. No product bundle has been analyzed.

appStrictTypecheck.result: Application TS/TSX strict check passed; own declaration inventory was empty and no declaration compiler ran.

decision.reason: The full third-party declaration check fails, the audit still reports four critical affected package entries, and only an isolated synthetic sample was built. This is not product or device acceptance evidence.
